# pcd_lb_listener (Resource)

Manages a listener on an Octavia load balancer in PCD.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pcd_networking_network" "example" {
  name = "tf-example-lb-net"
}

resource "pcd_networking_subnet" "example" {
  network_id = pcd_networking_network.example.id
  cidr       = "10.0.0.0/24"
}

resource "pcd_lb_loadbalancer" "example" {
  name          = "tf-example-lb"
  vip_subnet_id = pcd_networking_subnet.example.id
}

resource "pcd_lb_listener" "example" {
  name            = "tf-example-listener"
  loadbalancer_id = pcd_lb_loadbalancer.example.id
  protocol        = "TCP" # OVN provider is L4: TCP/UDP/SCTP
  protocol_port   = 80
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `loadbalancer_id` (String) The load balancer this listener belongs to. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `protocol` (String) The protocol: HTTP, HTTPS, TCP, TERMINATED_HTTPS, or UDP. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `protocol_port` (Number) The port to listen on. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `admin_state_up` (Boolean) The administrative state of the listener.
- `allowed_cidrs` (List of String) CIDRs allowed to connect to the listener.
- `connection_limit` (Number) Maximum connections (-1 for unlimited).
- `default_pool_id` (String) The default pool for the listener.
- `default_tls_container_ref` (String) Barbican secret ref for the default TLS certificate (TERMINATED_HTTPS).
- `description` (String) A description of the listener.
- `insert_headers` (Map of String) Headers to insert into requests before forwarding (e.g. X-Forwarded-For).
- `name` (String) The name of the listener.
- `region` (String) The region. Defaults to the provider's region.
- `sni_container_refs` (List of String) Barbican secret refs for SNI certificates.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags applied to the listener.
- `timeout_client_data` (Number) Frontend client inactivity timeout (in milliseconds).
- `timeout_member_connect` (Number) Backend member connection timeout (in milliseconds).
- `timeout_member_data` (Number) Backend member inactivity timeout (in milliseconds).
- `timeout_tcp_inspect` (Number) TCP inspection timeout (in milliseconds).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The listener ID.
- `operating_status` (String) The operating status.
- `provisioning_status` (String) The provisioning status.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import pcd_lb_listener.example <id>
```
